# Message

One message with its author and time.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Readers need sections, navigation and little else. People read from start to end; actions are rare: subscribe, share, save. No comments or feeds are among them. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a>, <a href="./alert">Alert</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Conversations, comments and activity feeds.
- **Not when:** Status about the system (alert or toast).

Instead:

- [Bubble](./bubble.md): A chat bubble.
- [Alert](./alert.md): A system message.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add message
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Message reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Message has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
